name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding Operations Leader | High-Volume Team Leadership, Scalable Process & AI Automation
summary: Onboarding operations leader with 15+ years in SaaS and remote-first teams. Led a team of 20 (later 8) onboarding specialists at Wix for two years, delivering 25+ launches per month personally at 110% of implementation targets while building the processes, training, and data standards that let a new business line scale to profitability. Builds AI and automation workflows hands-on, so knows how to spot repetitive work worth automating, define requirements with technical partners, and roll changes out with the right human oversight.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Break down manual operational workflows into automated and AI-assisted processes (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, n8n), with custom logic replacing repetitive steps end to end.
Built rubric-based evaluation criteria to grade AI-generated output against defined standards, reviewing and labeling the output personally.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into configurations and training client teams to adopt them.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' loosely defined needs into precise requirements and AI instructions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder accounts, holding delivery quality consistent and resolving client concerns promptly.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, retaining all but one of 15-20 reseller partners (~94%).
Built scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Analyzed utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team alongside an individual book, and built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training new specialists, and built sales training for tenured account executives.
Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Delivered 25+ onboardings and launches per month personally, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Defined and standardized the CRM fields for onboarding workflows, improving data capture and accuracy across the team.

Escalated account risk to leadership early and resolved it with direct guidance.
